newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Georg Fischer sees 1997 as good year.
newsitem.headline: Georg Fischer sees 1997 as good year.

text.p: Swiss engineering group Georg Fischer AG said it expected 1997 to be a good business year.
"The company expects 1997 to be another good business year," it said in a statement after the annual shareholder meeting.
The statement did not elaborate. Georg Fischer on March 12 reported 1996 net profit jumped 20 percent to 78 million Swiss francs from 65 million the year before.

It said shareholders approved the board's proposal to raise the dividend for registered shares to nine Swiss francs from seven francs the year before and to 45 francs per bearer share from 35 francs the year before.
